Method of Attack: Remote code execution via command injection vulnerability in go get command on Windows due to PATH lookup prioritizing local untrusted directories over system PATH
Execution of malicious gcc.exe included by attacker in local directory during cgo compilation
Command injection exploiting Windows shell behavior of searching current directory first for executables
Attack Vector: Running 'go get' command against a malicious repository
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious repository used with go get command
